comment: Tools the book's build downloads into .tools/ (git-ignored). Every archive is checked against the SHA-256 recorded here; for Node.js the official SHASUMS256.txt must agree too. CI and the Dockerfile read the same values.

lychee.comment: Gate (a)'s offline link check of the staged site and links.yml's weekly check of the pages' external links (plan/site.md, 'The three gates', 'CI'). Each SHA-256 is the digest GitHub's release API publishes for the asset, which equals the release's own <file>.sha256.

actionlint.comment: Checks .github/workflows/*.yml (CI's lint job). Each SHA-256 is the digest GitHub's release API publishes for the asset, which equals the release's actionlint_1.7.12_checksums.txt.

nginx.comment: Only to test deploy/ on Windows (tools/bootstrap.py --servers, tools/servertest.py), in the two versions the book is tested with (plan/critique/rulings-6.md, R23): 1.30.6, the container's version, and 1.20.1, what the owner's host runs. nginx.org publishes PGP signatures (<file>.asc) but no SHA-256: each hash is that of an archive whose signature was verified on 2026-11-10: 1.30.6 against Sergey Kandaurov's key D678 6CE3 03D9 A902 2998 DC6C C846 4D54 9AF7 5C0A (nginx.org/keys/pluknet.key), 1.20.1 against Maxim Dounin's key B0F4 2533 73F8 F6F5 10D4 2178 520A 9993 A1C0 52F8.
